pages.text:
This is Pip.
Pip is a little lion cub.
Pip is very, very quiet.

Pip is a mama, too.
This is her baby.
Her baby is a sock.

Pip puts on a sheet.
Now Pip is a ghost! A quiet ghost.
"boo," whispers Pip.

The big lions go
ROAR! ROAR! ROAR!
Pip goes... "boo."

The monkeys go
OOH-OOH-AH-AH!
Pip goes... "boo."

The elephant goes
TOOT! TOOT!
Pip goes... "boo."

Uh-oh.
Baby Sock starts to cry.
WAAH! WAAH!

Pip rocks her baby.
"Shh, shh, shh."
Everyone tiptoes. Shh.

Baby Sock falls fast asleep.
The lions, the monkeys
and the elephant fall asleep too.

Pip takes off her sheet.
She gives a big yawn...
and a teeny, tiny roar. "roar."
